ObjectName.value: Armed Man Fatally Shot by Pasadena Police During Fight With K9 After Pursuit

Categories.value: Media from YouTube|PD California|Uploaded with video2commons|April 2024 in California|2024 in Pasadena, California|Videos taken on 2024-04-13|Videos by PoliceActivity

ImageDescription.value:
Pasadena, California — On April 13, 2024, at 8:39 PM, officers from the Pasadena Police Department contacted an occupied suspicious vehicle on Hudson Avenue near Del Mar Boulevard. The vehicle, a white pick-up truck, was parked facing the wrong way on a one- way street. As officers were conducting their investigation and conversing with the driver, he suddenly sped off. While doing so, the suspect narrowly missed striking an officer with his truck. Now wanted for an assault with a deadly weapon on a police officer, units initiated a short vehicle pursuit that ended when the suspect crashed into the front yard of a home located in the 800 block of Arden Road.

The suspect fled from his vehicle and ran into the residential neighborhood. Officers established a containment and organized a search team to conduct yard-to-yard searches. While fleeing, the suspect forcibly entered two occupied residences. With the assistance of the Pasadena Police Department’s airship, officers located the suspect in the rear yard of a property located in the 700 block of Oak Knoll Circle. A K9 dog was first to contact the suspect, however, the suspect still refused to surrender. As the K9 dog was engaged with the suspect, the suspect produced a handgun.

The suspect refused to comply with orders to drop the handgun and an officer-involved shooting occurred. As a result of the shooting, the suspect sustained gunshot wounds. Officers performed life-saving measures on the suspect until paramedics from the Pasadena Fire Department arrived. Upon arrival, paramedics continued performing life-saving measures and transported the suspect to a local hospital. The suspect was later pronounced deceased. A handgun was recovered from the shooting scene. No officers were injured during the shooting. The suspect has been identified as 36-year-old Ricardo Guade Andrade, a San Fernando resident.

180732002.title: File:Body Camera Footage of Jerry Wade Gibson's Arrest - June 6, 2025.webm

ObjectName.value: Body Camera Footage of Jerry Wade Gibson's Arrest - June 6, 2025

Categories.value: Media from YouTube|PD Florida|Images with watermarks|Videos from Florida|Uploaded with video2commons|Videos of 2025 from the United States|Police making arrests in the United States|June 2025 in Florida|Police bodycam footage of the United States|Videos taken on 2025-06-06|Videos of people being arrested|Shooting tasers

ImageDescription.value:
On June 6th, while on patrol, Deputy Sampedro pulled into the Circle K at E. Highway 315 and E. Highway 316 and conducted a routine license plate check on a green Ford Focus. The check revealed the registered owner, Jerry Wade Gibson, had a suspended driver’s license.

Deputy Sampedro attempted a traffic stop, but Gibson chose to flee. He eventually stopped his vehicle near NE 142nd Place and NE 117th Court, then took off on foot.

Air-One responded to assist, along with K-9 Corporal DeMarco and his partner, K-9 Koen, and Deputies Sampedro and Thompson. Air-One quickly spotted Gibson hiding on a rooftop. Deputies issued commands, but Gibson ignored them and ran across the roof before jumping down and continuing to flee through nearby yards.

Despite repeated commands to stop, Gibson kept running. K-9 Koen was released and successfully apprehended him. As deputies moved in to place him in handcuffs, Gibson began striking and grabbing at K-9 Koen, and at one point jumping on top of him. Fearing for the K-9’s safety, Deputy Sampedro deployed his Taser, causing Gibson to release the dog. He was then secured and taken into custody.

What started as a simple traffic stop ended in a list of serious charges, including: Fleeing and Eluding Law Enforcement, Touch/Strike to Cause Harm to a Police Service Animal, Resisting Arrest, Driving While License Suspended or Revoked (DWLSR), Failure to Register a Motor Vehicle.
